questions.question: Why must a model record its dataset version?
options: Weights and code alone do not identify the exact training examples and features

questions.question: What makes a friendly label such as training_v3 insufficient by itself?
options: It may move unless it resolves to immutable metadata

questions.question: Which item belongs in a training dataset manifest?
options: Source snapshots, schema, feature versions, label rules, and quality evidence

questions.question: Why do training and evaluation data need separate version identities?
options: A correction or contamination removal can affect one set independently

questions.question: How can many dataset versions avoid copying all unchanged bytes?
options: Share immutable snapshot files or content-addressed objects through manifests
Use one mutable file for every version

questions.question: Why must rollback bind model and feature versions together?
options: Old weights may misinterpret newer feature semantics

questions.topic: Reproducible Training Data: Snapshots over Live Queries
questions.question: Why is saved SQL insufficient for exact training reproduction?
options: The same query can read changed live table state later

questions.topic: Reproducible Training Data: Snapshots over Live Queries
questions.question: What should a long training-data build do with source versions?
options: Read each source's latest state repeatedly
Use current wall clock as identity
Pin exact source snapshots before processing

questions.topic: Reproducible Training Data: Snapshots over Live Queries
questions.question: Why is a snapshot ID preferable to an as-of timestamp in final lineage?
options: It names one exact committed state
It always includes all future data

questions.topic: Reproducible Training Data: Snapshots over Live Queries
questions.question: How should an external API input without native snapshots be made reproducible?
options: Call the live API during every epoch
Capture immutable response bytes with checksums and metadata

questions.topic: Reproducible Training Data: Snapshots over Live Queries
questions.question: Why can independently taking the latest snapshot of facts and dimensions be inconsistent?
options: Both tables always have the same snapshot ID
They may represent different publication cycles rather than one coherent dataset cut

questions.topic: Reproducible Training Data: Snapshots over Live Queries
questions.question: What is the strongest proof of reproducibility?
options: The dataset has a friendly name
A clean rebuild from pinned lineage matches declared membership and value tolerances
